scope: Explicit lower-bound continuation, with no new comprehensive priority survey
verification: Two exact representations for each changed bound; deterministic phase delta; duplicate, undeleted-root and false-count rejection controls

research.signed_regions: Eighty local signed regions per dimension in 32–35D and 39D produced no gain in the recorded heuristic runs.
research.base_choices: All 756 independent Coxeter–Todd base alternatives pass exact old/new and new/new coset-distance checks. Changed-base phase seeds have not improved the registered bound.
research.pointwise_stars: Allowing individual signed star lines and partial middle deletions in the 383-star 39D pool reproduces the existing eight-point root trade; no larger bound is inferred.
